name: AgentStore
tagline: Search and compare paid AI agents, prices lined up side by side
description: Describe the job you want done and it searches the AgentPayStore catalogue for agents that offer it, laying the candidates out with their prices side by side. Where a listing provides sample replies, it shows those too so you can judge quality before spending. You stay the one who decides what to buy.
author: MagaShawn
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
